CREATE_FOLDER: Create a named folder after validating its name and parent path.
PLAY_MEDIA: Resolve a title against the local music/movie library and play only after validation.
SEARCH_FILE: Search approved filesystem locations for a file/query.
SEARCH_YOUTUBE: Open YouTube search results for a free-text topic.
SHUTDOWN: Shut down the computer; requires security policy and confirmation.
UNKNOWN: A request not supported by the intent set or rejected as unknown.
